info.title: Holy Hymns API
info.description: Self-hosted lyrics catalogue. Session authorization is checked on every protected request. All timestamps UTC. Public responses never contain drafts.

servers.description: Account-link landing pages are outside the versioned API prefix.

get.summary: Open an account email link in a browser or the installed app
get.description: Read-only HTML landing page. The email supplies #token=... in the URL fragment, never in an HTTP query parameter. GET and HEAD do not look up or consume tokens. The visitor can explicitly open the existing holyhymns:// app link, copy the code, or verify their email through POST /v1/auth/verify. No session is created. Assets at /auth/link.js and /auth/link.css are embedded in the API. Responses use no-store, no-referrer and a restrictive content security policy.

manualRevocationUrl.description: Present when an older linked Apple account has no stored grant. Local deletion succeeded; the user should remove the remaining Apple authorization using this URL.

429.description: Rate or free email quota exhausted

password.description: Required when the account has a password; otherwise omit and send {} after a fresh social sign-in.

delete.description: Requires a JSON body. Password-bearing accounts must supply the current password. Social-only accounts must have signed in within the last ten minutes and may send {}. Provider, idToken and nonce are not accepted here. The last active verified owner cannot delete their account. Success deletes personal identity/session/favorite data; anonymized audit records and aggregate analytics remain. If Apple is linked and a grant is stored, the server revokes it before deleting local data; revocation failure leaves the account intact for retry. Historical Apple accounts with no stored grant are deleted and return manualRevocationUrl so the user can remove the remaining Apple authorization.

get.description: Generate a single-use nonce valid for five minutes. Omit Authorization for social sign-in. For account linking, supply the existing account session so the challenge is bound to that user. Pass the nonce into the provider native sign-in request and then submit the same nonce with the returned ID token.

post.description: Use an unauthenticated /auth/challenge nonce in the provider sign-in request. Tokens must contain the same nonce, a configured audience and subject, valid signature/issuer, and an issuance time within ten minutes. Email matches do not link accounts: sign in to an existing account and use /auth/link/{provider}. Apple additionally requires authorizationCode from the same native sign-in attempt.

post.summary: Import one extracted Grejo Lyrics post as a private draft
post.description: Administrator or owner only. Uses durable source ID/hash deduplication and never overwrites app edits or publishes content. Matching source/hash returns unchanged; a changed hash returns conflicts in the 200 report. A non-dry import commits draft, taxonomy, first revision, import run and lyrics.import actor audit atomically. Retry failed requests safely. Existing 1 MiB body limit applies; only one JSON object and documented fields are accepted.

400.description: Invalid source, metadata, song content, JSON or oversized request body

500.description: Import or audit failed; retry safely using the same sourceId and hash. No partial import can commit.

503.description: Server busy or transaction timed out; retry safely

SongInput.description: Full editable draft content. At least one nonblank title is required. Both lyric scripts may be empty in drafts; publishing requires one. Omitted editable fields become their defaults; this is not a partial patch. Combined lyrics are limited to 200,000 UTF-8 bytes.

SongUpdateInput.description: Complete draft payload plus the current version. A stale version returns 409.

version.description: Configuration edit version, distinct from the global published content revision.

AppConfigInput.description: Complete editable app settings plus the current configuration version. Omitted text fields become empty; this is not a partial patch.

reviewNotes.description: Administrative review notes; omitted from public song responses.

SongRevisionContent.description: Historical content as saved; metadata can be empty for initial imported/created snapshots. Use the enclosing revision id/version when restoring.

LyricsImportEntry.description: One extracted Grejo Lyrics post. At least one nonblank title is required. Lyrics together are limited to 200,000 UTF-8 bytes; no usable lyrics returns a skipped report. Null characters and RawHTML are not accepted. Labels are trimmed and deduplicated. Hash is normalized to lowercase.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical HTTPS post permalink only; maximum 2048 UTF-8 bytes. No credentials, port, query, fragment or escaped path.

items.description: Nonblank after trimming; no line breaks.

url.description: HTTPS URL with host and without credentials; at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

dryRun.description: Read-only validation and preview; no song, category, revision, import run or audit is written.
